milestone: Vertical kit gains a /compare/ page: 17 checks are past what a reader can hold in their head
why: at seventeen checks, guessing which one applies is how a tool gets ignored. One table generated from the same CHECKS data the individual pages use, so it cannot drift from them, plus a by-file-type chooser list.
generated_from: scripts/checks-data.mjs via scripts/build-site.mjs — the same source the per-check pages and llms.txt read
deploy: site build now reports 19 pages; /compare/ returns 200 after the Pages deploy

indexnow.reason: the configured endpoint https://www.bing.com/indexnow and the fallback https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow both returned 000 (connection failed) from this network across four attempts; the preflight also correctly refused before deploy, then the push succeeded
indexnow.mitigation: the page is in sitemap.xml (200) and llms.txt, and linked from the home page, so ordinary crawling finds it; IndexNow is an accelerator, not the only path
indexnow.note: the preflight that refused a 404 URL before submitting is good behaviour and is why the failure is unambiguous
